thesis: Registry can push settings to AMMStandardHook between beforeSwap and afterSwap calls via registryUpdateTokenSettings (L519). No mutex or swap-in-progress check. Governance trust assumption, not exploitable by external users.

All 6 trust boundaries (Core-PoolType, Core-Handler, Core-Hook, Hook-Registry, PoolType-Core return, Handler-External) have defense-in-depth: balance-delta checks, _validateProtocolFees, _safeDecrementUint128, _requireCallerIsAMM, reentrancy guard with ENTERED bit preservation. No exploitable gaps found.
